expenses_cancellation_ck.name: expenses_cancellation_ck
expenses_cancellation_ck.value: (`expenses`.`status` = 'recorded' AND `expenses`.`cancelled_at` IS NULL AND `expenses`.`cancellation_reason` IS NULL) OR (`expenses`.`status` = 'cancelled' AND `expenses`.`cancelled_at` IS NOT NULL AND `expenses`.`cancellation_reason` IS NOT NULL)

payments_cancellation_ck.name: payments_cancellation_ck
payments_cancellation_ck.value: (`payments`.`status` = 'received' AND `payments`.`cancelled_at` IS NULL AND `payments`.`cancellation_reason` IS NULL) OR (`payments`.`status` = 'cancelled' AND `payments`.`cancelled_at` IS NOT NULL AND `payments`.`cancellation_reason` IS NOT NULL)

projects_dates_ck.name: projects_dates_ck
projects_dates_ck.value: `projects`.`end_date` IS NULL OR `projects`.`start_date` IS NULL OR `projects`.`end_date` >= `projects`.`start_date`
